Hi Laura, Vivek —

Quick note from our marketing team: we’re planning to announce our integration with Redwood on Oct 10. Marketing wants a short customer quote + permission to use a 300–400 word case study and logo on our website.

Can Redwood provide a short quote (one line + a 1–2 sentence supporting blurb) and confirm you’re OK with the case study being published the same day? Also can we lock the press release time to Oct 10, 14:00 UTC?

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Laura —

Here are three quote options I drafted (pick one or we can combine snippets):

1) Executive endorsement (short):
“Partnering with Redwood Inference helped us bring large language features to production faster — with predictable latency and lower per-request cost.”

2) Results-focused (recommended):
“Redwood’s serving platform reduced end-to-end inference latency by ~35% and cut operational token costs by an estimated 22%, letting us ship smarter features without compromising on SLAs.”

3) Product-first (team-friendly):
“Redwood’s unified runtime and smart routing made it straightforward for our engineers to standardize inference across environments — production-ready in weeks, not months.”

A few notes: confirm the numbers with Monica (CS) before publishing; we should avoid exact QPS numbers in the public quote — high-level percentages are fine. I’ve uploaded a working case study draft here: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aB_case_study_draft (internal draft).

If Tom/Amanda prefer a shorter line + blurbs, option 2 reads strongest for press.

Vivek
